description: Single source of truth for the local GUI builder. Every build variant the CI offers is described here once: the builder it drives, the inputs the form shows, and a declarative paramMap onto that builder's PowerShell parameters. tests/Test-LocalGui.Tests.ps1 asserts the paramMap targets really exist in the builder's param block and that every input key exists in the matching workflow, so this file cannot drift silently from either side.

app.name: Tiny11 Local Builder
app.tagline: Build Tiny11 ISOs on your own machine

isoSources.label: Download from Microsoft
isoSources.help: Mints a fresh signed link at build time (~5.8 GB). Links expire after ~24 hours, so this is safer than pasting one.

isoSources.label: Use an ISO file on this PC
isoSources.help: Pick a .iso already on disk. Skips the download entirely and works offline.

isoSources.label: Use a mounted drive
isoSources.help: Point at a drive letter that already has the Windows media mounted.

updateModes.label: Required
updateModes.help: Download and inject the newest cumulative update before debloating. The build fails if it cannot be applied.

updateModes.label: Best effort
updateModes.help: Try to inject the newest cumulative update, but keep going at the base build if it fails.

updateModes.label: Off
updateModes.help: Build from the ISO exactly as Microsoft shipped it.

gamingGroups.label: Disable CPU idle states
gamingGroups.help: Can raise idle power draw and temperatures.

gamingGroups.label: Disable security mitigations
gamingGroups.help: Trades Spectre/Meltdown class protections for throughput.

gamingGroups.label: Remove Xbox / Game Bar stack
gamingGroups.help: Drops GameDVR, Game Bar and the Xbox services.

gamingGroups.label: Disable fast startup
gamingGroups.help: Fast startup breaks true shutdowns and dual-boot.

gamingGroups.label: Disable MPO
gamingGroups.help: Multi-Plane Overlay off; fixes some flicker and stutter.

gamingGroups.label: Disable fullscreen optimisations
gamingGroups.help: Forces true exclusive fullscreen in older titles.

gamingGroups.label: Disable Game Mode
gamingGroups.help: Windows Game Mode off; the profile does its own scheduling.

gamingGroups.label: Remove printing
gamingGroups.help: Drops the print spooler and drivers.

variants.label: Tiny11 LTSC
variants.subtitle: Long-term servicing
variants.description: LTSC media with the Tiny11 treatment. No Store, no Copilot, no feature updates - supported for years instead of months.
variants.isoNote: Microsoft does not publish LTSC ISOs on the consumer download page, so you must supply your own ISO or mounted drive.
variants.derivedNote: The image index comes from the LTSC catalogue entry, not from a form field: LTSC media numbers its images differently from the consumer ISO, and the builder re-checks the name via -ExpectedEdition anyway.
